units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 12:42">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XII, 42</cite>. Targ.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:8">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מָכָא ליה ארעא וכ׳</he> the ground under him became soft.

senses.gloss: (denom. of מוךְ) to lay under, make a bed.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 139:8">Targ. Ps. CXXXIX, 8</cite>.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 49a:20">Pes. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>בר מָךְ רבע</he> one who lays under (his cloak) and lies down (at any place, a shiftless person).

<cite ref="Taanit 6b:11">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 59a:11">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>כד מפתח בבי … מוֹךְ שקיך וגני</he> if it rains when the doors are opened (in the morning), lay down thy bag, ass-driver, and sleep (do not export, for provisions will be cheap); a. e.—Part. <cite ref="M00036"><he>מָאֵיךְ</he></cite>, <cite ref="M00036"><he>מָיֵיךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:1">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>הוו מָיְיכֵי ליה וכ׳</he> (Rashi: <he>מָיְיכִין</he>; Var. <cite ref="M01146"><he>מייתי</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 1) they spread for him sixty mattresses.

<cite ref="Taanit 21b">Taan. 21ᵇ</cite> bot. <cite ref="M00036"><he>מאיך</he></cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="M01339"><he>מך</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="B00665"><he>בִּיסְתַּרְקָא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="M01341"><he>מָכָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 113:6">Targ. Ps. CXIII, 6</cite> <he>מְמֵיךְ</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="M00036"><he>מַמֵיךְ</he></cite>, <he>מֵמִיךְ</he>; h. text <he>המשפילי</he>).

senses.gloss: to make soft, crush. Ib. XLIV, 20 (h. text דִּכָּה).

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 41:22">Targ. Job XLI, 22</cite> (h. text <he>רפד</he>).
